24.name: Episode 1
24.overview: It Takes Two is back with new host Ellie Taylor. In a series packed full of the latest headlines, backstage gossip, expert opinions and exclusive interviews, Ellie keeps things up to date with all of the celebs and their pro dance partners throughout the Strictly season.

24.name: Episode 2
24.overview: Ellie Taylor dishes up more unmissable backstage gossip and behind-the-scenes action from the world of Strictly as the celebs prepare for their next dances. Also, the five new pros join Ellie in studio for a catch-up.

24.name: Episode 3
24.overview: Ellie Taylor has an exciting look at all the backstage ballroom action, with a panel of Strictly pros stopping by for a chat. Plus an exclusive first look at how some of the celebrities are handling their new dances.

24.name: Episode 4
24.overview: Ellie Taylor is back with even more backstage gossip from the world of Strictly Come Dancing as more celebs stop by with some exclusives about their upcoming performances. Also, Strictly’s costume designer, Vicky Gill, has a sneak peek at some of the weekend’s outfits.

24.name: Episode 5
24.overview: With the first elimination of the series looming, Ellie Taylor chats to the remaining celebs before their next live performances. Also, a panel of former Strictly celebs and pros get an exclusive look at all of the couples' weekend dances for the first time on the Strictly ballroom floor.

24.name: Episode 6

originalTitle: Strictly Come Dancing: It Takes Two
overview: The companion show to the popular BBC One programme Strictly Come Dancing which features interviews and training footage of the couples competing in the main Saturday night show, opinions from the judges on the previous Saturday show and the training footage for the next, and interviews with celebrities who have been watching the show.
title: Strictly Come Dancing: It Takes Two
